title: GitHub Actions Matrix Strategy — Runnable Workflows
title_es: Matrix de GitHub Actions — Workflows ejecutables
description: Three ready-to-run GitHub Actions workflows: a static OS x Node matrix with exclude/include and per-cell cache keys, a services matrix (PostgreSQL/MySQL), and a dynamic matrix driven by supported-versions.json with an empty-matrix guard.
description_es: Tres workflows de GitHub Actions listos para usar: una matrix estática de SO × Node con exclude/include y claves de caché por celda, una matrix de servicios (PostgreSQL/MySQL) y una matrix dinámica dirigida por supported-versions.json con guarda anti-matrix-vacía.
